g.text: Runtime events to product UI projection
Running and failed tools stay expanded.
Successful tools collapse after the final answer.
Input appears above output in one vertical detail body.
Tools that have not started are not shown.
No second card is created for late metadata.
Completed thinking collapses to Analysis process.
Do not invent a duration without timestamps.
- map internal paths and resource IDs
- clamp depth, length, and collection size
- never activate HTML, Markdown, or URLs
Network loss does not replay the POST.
No running-message queue in the current product.
Stop first, then submit a new message.
Other event mappings above are the v1 migration baseline.
